description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Azure streaming and lease provider components in an Orleans silo builder. It provides methods to add Azure Queue persistent streams and to configure Azure Blob lease providers, including service registration and options setup.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Azure streaming and lease provider services in the Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Queue persistent streams with a specific configuration.

methods.name: AddAzureQueueStreams
methods.description: Overload that configures Azure Queue persistent streams with default settings via options.

methods.name: UseAzureBlobLeaseProvider
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob lease provider with specified options.

methods.name: ConfigureAzureBlobLeaseProviderServices
methods.description: Private helper method to register services related to Azure Blob lease provider.

methods.name: UseAzureBlobLeaseProvider
methods.description: Extension method to configure Azure Blob lease provider on a silo persistent stream configurator.
